title.en: Extending the Term of Office of the Present Kabataang Barangay Officers

text.en:
The pertinent provisions of Presidential Decree No. 684 limiting the membership of the youth
organizations to barangay residents below 18 years of age are hereby suspended to allow the Kabataang
Barangay officers to continue in office.

The Secretary of Local Government and Community Development shall promulgate such rules
and regulations as may be deemed necessary to effectively implement the provisions of this Decree.

All provisions of laws, orders and decrees as well as rules and regulations inconsistent herewith
are hereby modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
